messages:
alex: Heads-up on Pioneer POC — syncing timeline & open deps before next week. Can owners confirm milestones? TL;DR: integration + staging cutover windows.
priya: Owners here. I'll own API contract + certs. Targeting staged endpoint by Wed 03/20. Need infra to open port 8443 and DNS changes.
liam: On infra — we'll open the port and do DNS on Tue night. @tess can you confirm cert rotation? Also need CVE scan completed.
tess: Yep, cert rotation scheduled Tue and CVE scan queued. Small ask: can SE drop a sample request body so we can validate mapping?
alex: SE sample: `{ "user_input": "Hello", "context": [] }` — also note webhook auth: HMAC header x-rw-signature.
priya: Added schema to the confluence doc (https://confluence.internal/redwood/pioneer-poc). Also code review ping — PR #482 needs a quick look. @liam @tess please.
liam: I'll review PR tonight, ETA ~2h.
tess: Reviewed, left 2 small nits in PR comments. :white_check_mark:
sean: Quick question on success criteria: is latency SLO p50=300ms or p95=300ms? Sales needs the exact wording for the customer demo.
alex: Goal is p50 < 150ms, p95 < 700ms. For the demo we can promise p50 < 200ms. We'll route demo traffic to the dedicated pool so numbers are stable.
priya: Thanks. Another dep: customer requires SSO via SAML. Who's handling the SAML onboarding?
liam: Platform will handle SAML setup; I'm on the loop but need the customer's metadata XML. @alex can you collect and drop it here?
alex: On it — will email product@ and cc @priya, then paste metadata here. Final check: can we do a dry-run on Fri 03/22 after infra & certs?
tess: Fri dry-run works for me assuming certs are in place. If infra finishes Tue night we should be clear.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging infra changes — Tue 02:00-03:00 UTC. No rollback expected unless CI fails.
priya: Awesome. Acceptance checklist for handoff: 1) endpoint reachable, 2) certs valid, 3) CI & e2e green, 4) SAML metadata accepted by platform, 5) PR #482 merged. I'll update the POC doc with these gates.
alex: Perfect. I'll update the customer timeline and ping them with the demo window. Thanks all :pray:
